channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chris Bosh | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chris Bosh from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Bobby Portis on Ray Allen, Chris Bosh, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Bobby Portis on being a Heat fan his whole life, and conversations he had with Giannis about coming to Miami:

“I’ve been a Heatle. I’ve been rocking with the Heat since the Mavericks and the Spurs in the finals. Ray Allen in the corner, Chris Bosh offensive rebound, pass out to the corner, bow! Everybody thought it was over with the ropes out. The conversations I had with Giannis has just always been about winning. Where can we go to win? How can we get another championship? Once you guys talk to him at 3 you’ll understand all he cares about is winning.”

Bobby Portis on Ray Allen, Chris Bosh, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jul 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Micky Arison on LeBron James, Chris Bosh
item.description:
Miami Heat ownerMicky Arison:

“In 2010, with Dwyane, LeBron and Chris Bosh we knew we could win. Not 1, not 2... I guess it was just 2.”

Micky Arison on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Sep 8, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Udonis Haslem
item.description:
Hassan Whiteside:

“One of the best memories I have from my time in Miami was meeting guys like D-Wade, Chris Bosh, and Udonis Haslem. When I first got to the Heat, I was getting suspended, getting into fights, and Bosh was always in my ear, telling me,‘Hassan, you worked all this time to get here. Why are you throwing it away?’ He was one of the people who really helped me get my head straight.”

Hassan Whiteside on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Udonis Haslem, Aug 27, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Joakim Noah on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Noah said of the 2010 free agency frenzy.

“… Chis Bosh basically told me, ‘Yo, I’m coming to Chicago.’ If Chris Bosh came to Chicago…“I tried to recruit all of them. It didn’t matter. Whatever it took to get the Bulls better, I was doing. Derrick (Rose) wasn’t doing none of that s–t. I was doing all of that. People don’t know that, but yes, I did try to recruit LeBron. Yes, I did try to recruit D-Wade.”

Joakim Noah on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Nov 8, 2022. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: LeBron James on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Mark Medina:LeBron James on to what extent he'll draw from the times in Miami he elevated his game without a healthy D-Wade or Chris Bosh:

“The best teacher of life is experience. To me, personally I look forward to the challenge. However the hand is dealt, I'll be ready to play.”

LeBron James on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, May 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Erik Spoelstra on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Erik Spoelstra on Chris Bosh:

“His stories of sacrifice and what it means to be a leader and impact winning, those stories are going to be told in my locker rooms forever.”

Erik Spoelstra on Chris Bosh, May 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Penny Hardaway on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Penny Hardaway:

“Parts of his game remind me of Chris Bosh. I know that’s a stretch for a lot of people. But when I see him, the way he’s been able to work his way out to the 3-point line, there are similarities to Bosh. But he’s way more athletic.”

Penny Hardaway on Chris Bosh, Oct 28, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: David West on Chris Bosh, Andrea Bargnani
item.description:
David West:

“I thought about this the other day. When [Andrea] Bargnani and [Chris] Bosh were in Toronto, the reason why that sh** didn't work is 'cause the NBA let us beat them up! We beat up Bargnani, they let us body Bosh. Like, Bosh and Bargnani right now, they would blow this NBA out of the water. They were damn near impossible to guard. I'm serious. The only reason Bargnani didn't have a (successful) career was 'cause the referees let people like me beat him up!”

David West on Chris Bosh, Andrea Bargnani, Oct 15, 2020. Source: basketballnews.com.

item.title: Pat Riley on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade
item.description:
“LeBron and Chris [Bosh], two of the greatest players in our game. And LeBron, maybe the greatest player of all time, with Dwyane [Wade]. All you have to do is put it on the table.”

Pat Riley on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, May 3, 2020. Source: Heat Nation.

item.title: Pat Riley on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Anthony Chiang:Riley:

“I just want to welcome Chris Bosh forever, and for always, a lifer of the Miami Heat.”

Pat Riley on Chris Bosh, Mar 26, 2019. Source: Twitter @Anthony_Chiang.

item.title: Luke Walton on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade
item.description:
Luke Walton on being in the '03 draft class:

“I feel a lot of pride. I feel like I brought a lot to the table as far as being one of the top draft classes of all time. I mean, guys like LeBron and D-Wade and Bosh and Walton … We really did our thing.”

Luke Walton on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Dec 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @kylegoon.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Then came Wednesday, the prelude to Bosh's No. 1 jersey (since unissued) being raised to the rafters, just as James' No. 6 eventually will be.

“We couldn't walk around as proud as we are without Chris Bosh,”

Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh, Oct 27, 2018. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng, Joe Johnson
item.description:
“You know when you come to a new team it’s hard to find your spot at first. We had (Chris Bosh) at first, we had D-Wade, Joe Johnson, Luol Deng; there were a lot of players they were good and you just need time to adjust and fit into the system.“You could see the last year together we demonstrated we can play together.”

Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh, Dwyane Wade, Luol Deng, Joe Johnson, Feb 13, 2018. Source: Palm Beach Post.

item.title: Steve Smith on Chris Bosh
item.description:
“I think in broadcasting it's also great that you can tell, no matter what the situation, he never really got outside of being Chris Bosh. So I think that's another trait that he has that would be perfect for broadcasting.”

Steve Smith on Chris Bosh, Jun 5, 2017. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Dan Le Batard on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Dan Le Batard on the Chris Bosh situation:

“(Chris Bosh) wasn't fighting this recent report of him failing the physical, but he was absolutely distrustful of everything the Heat doctors were telling him. I don't know what's happening with him in terms of whether it's bulletproof or delusion but at every point he was not trusting what it is that the doctors were telling him and he got his own people involved to double-check everything that the doctors were telling him.”

Dan Le Batard on Chris Bosh, Sep 26, 2016. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Shane Battier on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Shane Battier on Chris Bosh:

“I feel for Chris and I feel for the #Heat. I know in his heart of hearts he wants to play.”

Shane Battier on Chris Bosh, Sep 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson
item.description:
Toward the close of the email, Arison wrote:

“What won't change is the culture of this organization. The Miami HEAT is a Championship organization. I fully expect this team, from Pat Riley to Head Coach Erik Spoelstra, to our veterans Chris Bosh, Udonis Haslem, Goran Dragic and Josh McRoberts, to our returning young core of Hassan Whiteside, Justise Winslow, Josh Richardson and Tyler Johnson, to the fresh faces joining the HEAT Family to continue our mantra of being the 'hardest working, best conditioned, most professional, unselfish, toughest, meanest, nastiest team in the NBA.'”

Micky Arison on Chris Bosh, Hassan Whiteside, Pat Riley, Udonis Haslem, Erik Spoelstra, Goran Dragic, Josh McRoberts, Josh Richardson, Justise Winslow, Tyler Johnson, Aug 12, 2016. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Udonis Haslem on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Haslem on Bosh:

“I don't really know. Nobody knows what the situation is gonna be with Chris. I'm preparing that he's gonna be healthy.”

Udonis Haslem on Chris Bosh, Jul 12, 2016. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.

item.title: Mario Chalmers on Chris Bosh, Kevin Love
item.description:
Sirius XM NBA:Mario Chalmers on if Kevin Love fits with the Cavs:

“I think he can be a good fit. If I was Kevin Love I would call Chris Bosh.”

Mario Chalmers on Chris Bosh, Kevin Love, Jun 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @SiriusXMNBA.

item.title: Pat Riley on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Pat Riley on Chris Bosh:

“We're all very encouraged by trying to find a way over the next 2-3 months to find a protocol to get him back playing.”

Pat Riley on Chris Bosh, May 18, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Finally, on his defiant, explosive drive to the rim, and finish with 12.6 seconds left, it was none.

“(Chris Bosh) kept coming up to me, and he kept saying, ‘If we’re going to go out, I want to go out with you having the ball,”

Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh, May 10, 2016. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Adam Silver on Chris Bosh
item.description:
“In a joint statement, the Heat and Bosh said Wednesday that he will miss the rest of the postseason, in the wake of strong indications that Bosh wanted to play. “It seems like the science is clear here,”

Adam Silver on Chris Bosh, May 9, 2016. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Adam Silver on Chris Bosh
item.description:
“There is no dispute here between the player and the team and the league as to what the condition is. This is primarily a relationship matter between the Miami Heat and [Bosh]. He is a fantastic guy and a wonderful player—obviously I feel for him that he’s out right now.”

Adam Silver on Chris Bosh, May 9, 2016. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Dragic on if Bosh spoke on plane ride home about how bad he wants to play:

“He didn't but you can see it. He's emotional like he's playing.”

Goran Dragic on Chris Bosh, Apr 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Pat Riley on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Pat Riley on Chris Bosh:

“We're just supportive of Chris... we're just going to wait and see what the future holds.”

Pat Riley on Chris Bosh, Mar 20, 2016. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: Steve Kerr on LeBron James, Chris Bosh
item.description:
Warriors coach Steve Kerr said.

“I was covering that Heat team with TNT, was here all the time. It seemed like the negativity came simply because LeBron left Cleveland, and people didn't like the idea that it was a superteam. And Bosh left Toronto. Like somehow they were cheating or something. Which was insane to look at it that way. Everybody was free to do what they wanted as free agents. And why wouldn't they do what they did? It was special. I think with our team, there's none of that negativity because the team was basically homegrown, with the core of the team mostly drafted or traded for, and it wasn't like this Superteam pulling together.”

Steve Kerr on LeBron James, Chris Bosh, Feb 24, 2016. Source: Miami Herald.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Manny Navarro:Dwyane Wade:

“[Bosh is] still a big part of this team. He comes in and watches film with guys, does different things. He's a leader on all fronts.”

Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh, Feb 23, 2016. Source: Twitter @Manny_Navarro.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Michael Lee:Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh:

“CB's been around. I talked to him. The way his personality is, what he gives to the team, no one has to worry about him.”

Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh, Feb 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Michael Lee:Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh:

“We're not waiting to get the word on him... We know he's going to do everything possible to get back on the court with us.”

Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh, Feb 22, 2016. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh
item.description:
Jason Lieser:Wade on whether Bosh will make it on the coaches' vote:

“Oh, 100 percent. I’m not worried about Chris at all. He’ll be in there.”

Dwyane Wade on Chris Bosh, Jan 21, 2016. Source: Twitter @JasonLieser.
